# shopify_blog (Resource)

An online store blog: the container for articles, with handle, title, comment policy and template. **A good fit for Terraform:** these settings are stable configuration. The articles are content and are not managed by this resource. Changing the handle changes the URL of every article in the blog, and no URL redirect is created. Destroying a blog deletes its articles too, so a blog with articles needs `allow_data_deletion = true` in state first; an empty blog is deleted without it. A blog that already has the handle, such as `news` which every store has, needs `adopt_existing = true`; destroy then leaves it in place. Import with the handle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every store has news; adopting it manages the title and comment policy, and destroy leaves it in place.
resource "shopify_blog" "news" {
  handle         = "news"
  title          = "Ratgeber"
  comment_policy = "MODERATED"
  adopt_existing = true
}

# Articles are not managed here. Renaming the handle changes every article URL, without redirects.
resource "shopify_blog" "magazin" {
  handle          = "magazin"
  title           = "Magazin"
  template_suffix = "magazin"

  # Destroying a blog with articles deletes them; set this and apply before destroying.
  allow_data_deletion = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) The blog's URL handle, unique per shop. Changing it renames the blog in place and creates no URL redirect. Shopify gives a taken handle a suffix (`news-1`) instead of failing; the provider checks for that and fails instead. Lower case, no whitespace: Shopify lower-cases anything else.
- `title` (String) The blog title.

### Optional

- `adopt_existing` (Boolean) Take over an existing blog with the same natural key instead of failing. Destroy then only removes it from state. Defaults to `false`.
- `allow_data_deletion` (Boolean) Allow destroying or replacing this blog, which deletes the data stored in it. Defaults to `false`. Must already be `true` in state when the delete runs, so set it in a separate apply first.
- `comment_policy` (String) Whether readers can comment, and whether comments are moderated: `AUTO_PUBLISHED`, `CLOSED` or `MODERATED`. A new blog is `CLOSED` when this is unset. Unset means unmanaged: the value set in the admin is kept.
- `template_suffix` (String) Theme template suffix, such as `ratgeber` for `blog.ratgeber.json`. Null and an empty string both mean the default template, and each reads back as given. Unset means unmanaged: the value set in the admin is kept.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Blog GID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <handle>
terraform import shopify_blog.news news
```
